title: Los Angeles landfill gas release: County declares emergency eight days after plume of gas, debris sent six to hospital
summary_full: Los Angeles County has taken urgent action by declaring a local emergency following a notable gas release from Chiquita Canyon Landfill. The incident not only prompted the evacuation of local residents but also led to six individuals being hospitalized with minor injuries. Authorities are worried about the potential for additional hazardous releases and have sought state help.
